attempts.summary: Opened exactly one firewall path through node1 (OPNsense): node2 (lan-a) to node3 (lan-b) on TCP/8080, leaving every other cross-LAN flow refused by default-deny. Discovered and registered node1's unconfigured vtnet1/vtnet2 as opt1(LANA)/opt2(LANB) interfaces, added one pf pass rule scoped to opt1-net -> 192.168.20.2:8080, added persistent static routes on node2/node3, and fixed a node3-local firewalld rule that was independently blocking inbound 8080. Verified the allowed path works and all other paths (ICMP, other ports, reverse direction) remain refused, both before and after sequentially restarting all three nodes with proven boot-identity changes and full post-restart recovery.
